description: This file defines a factory function 'make_distribution_for_install_requirement' that creates and returns an appropriate distribution object (SourceDistribution, WheelDistribution, or SourceDistribution again) based on the properties of an InstallRequirement instance.

methods.name: AbstractDistribution make_distribution_for_install_requirement( install_req: InstallRequirement, )
methods.description: Creates a distribution object based on the properties of the given InstallRequirement, returning a SourceDistribution, WheelDistribution, or another SourceDistribution depending on whether the requirement is editable or a wheel.
